correctness.rationale: For a part V_i, writing t_i for the number of negative labels outside V_i gives the exact identity f(N[u])=c_i-2t_i+f(u). The standard minimality witness condition forces any minimal SDF to have at least floor((N-L)/2) negative vertices. The explicit construction with that many negatives outside a largest part is checked directly to satisfy every closed-neighborhood inequality, and every positive vertex has a tight witness in the largest part. Exhaustive literal verification through order 10 agrees with the theorem.

value.rationale: The upper signed domination number is a natural established invariant, and complete multipartite graphs are a standard structured family. The result replaces the bipartite-only exact formula by a closed expression for every number of parts, shows the invariant depends only on order and largest-part size, and supplies a maximum-weight construction. This is a structural exact evaluation rather than a routine numerical instance.
